boards.description: Tracks all new patient acquisition campaigns running for dental practice clients — Google Ads, Facebook, new mover, and implant campaigns. One item per active campaign.

boards.name: Website & SEO Projects
boards.description: Website builds and ongoing SEO retainer work for dental clients. Tracks discovery, development, review, and live stages for all web and SEO projects.

column_values.notes: 3-location group practice in San Diego. $4,200/mo retainer covering Google Ads, SEO, social, and monthly reporting. Dr. Martinez is very engaged and a strong reference account. Contract renews Jan 2027.
Single-location cosmetic and general dentistry practice in Newport Beach. $2,800/mo retainer. Dr. Nguyen is focused on growing Invisalign and whitening cases. New mover campaign launched Sept.

2-location family dentistry group in San Diego (Hillcrest and North Park). $3,600/mo retainer. Running Facebook lead gen, local SEO, and content. Dr. Park wants to add a third location — expansion marketing opportunity.
4-location group practice in San Diego. Demo scheduled Oct 28. They're currently with a generalist agency and not happy with their results. Strong implant focus. Potential $4,500–$5,000/mo retainer.

Brand new practice in downtown San Diego, opened Aug 2026. Dr. Chen needs a new website and full marketing launch. Proposal sent Oct 18 at $3,200/mo (includes website build + ongoing). Waiting on decision.
Contacted 3 times over 4 months. Dr. Pham likes what we showed but says they're locked into a current vendor contract through Dec 2026. Set a reminder to follow up Jan 2027 when contract expires.

Left at end of August after 18 months. Moved to a larger national agency that offered a lower price point. Exit call revealed they wanted more reporting transparency. Documenting learnings for dashboard improvements.

items.name: Sunshine Dental - Google Ads Q4 Campaign

column_values.notes: $2,500/mo ad spend across Google Search and Performance Max. Targeting general dentistry, implants, and emergency dental in San Diego. CPL currently $42 — down from $58 in Q3. 3 locations all active.

items.name: Pacific Coast Smiles - New Mover Campaign

column_values.notes: Targeting new residents within 5 miles of the Newport Beach practice via direct mail + digital retargeting. New movers convert at 3x the rate of general paid search for this client. 14 new patient calls attributed in first 30 days.

Cost per lead running at $68 vs $45 target. Audience is too broad — testing narrower age/income targeting and new creative with Devon. Also testing a 'Free Exam' offer vs 'Meet the Doctor' hook. Results due EOW.

New client starting Nov 1. Building out a dental implant Google Ads campaign. High-value service — targeting cost per lead under $90. Keyword research and landing page brief in progress. Coordinating with Olivia on LP build.

Full WordPress redesign for all 3 Sunshine Dental locations. New brand direction approved by Dr. Martinez. Homepage and services pages built. Now building out location pages and the new patient forms. Dev site: dev.sunshinedentalsd.com.

October SEO deliverables: on-page optimization for 12 service pages, 4 new blog posts (cosmetic dentistry topics), and GMB profile cleanup. All content drafted. Marcus reviewing for client tone before we publish.

Prospect (Downtown Dental Studio) needs a brand new website. Discovery questionnaire sent. Gathering competitor examples, branding preferences, and service priorities. Proposal will include 5-page site + booking integration at $6,500 one-time.

Ongoing local SEO for both Hillcrest locations. Sunshine Dental now ranking #3 for 'dentist San Diego' and #1 for 'family dentist Hillcrest'. Building citations and local landing pages for the North Park location. Monthly rank tracking in place.

16 posts scheduled for October across Instagram and Facebook (3 locations). Mix of patient education, team spotlights, and Halloween-themed dental hygiene content. All approved by Dr. Martinez. Scheduled in Sprout Social through Oct 31.

Producing a before/after smile transformation campaign for Dr. Nguyen's Invisalign and veneers cases. Dr. Nguyen provided 6 patient photos (consents signed). Devon designing the carousel templates. Copy review with Priya before final approval.

Planning November/December holiday content for both Hillcrest locations. Will include Thanksgiving 'grateful smiles' posts, holiday whitening promotion, and New Year new smile theme. Content brief in progress — need Dr. Park's promotional offers confirmed before finalizing.

Lakeside Dental Group signed Oct 21 — starting Nov 1. Kick-off call scheduled Oct 24. Onboarding checklist initiated. Need to collect: GMB access, website credentials, Facebook Business Manager access, and practice management software login for call tracking setup.

Contract pending final signature from Dr. Chen. While we wait, beginning domain setup and Google Analytics 4 configuration. Will not move forward on paid media or website until contract is fully executed.

Google Ads data pulled. SEO rank report exported. Social metrics compiled. Now building the executive summary and KPI scorecard in our reporting template. Target delivery Oct 28 — Dr. Martinez has a leadership meeting on the 30th.
Pulling October data: Google Analytics, Google Ads, call tracking (CallRail), and GMB insights. New mover campaign reporting will be included for the first time this month.

Collecting Facebook Ads data, SEO rankings, website traffic, and call volume for both locations. Jake pulling rank movement data for the Local SEO section. Facebook CPL optimization section will be highlighted given the current campaign issues.

3-location ortho and general dentistry group in Carlsbad. Proposal sent Oct 15 at $3,800/mo. They're evaluating two agencies. Follow-up call scheduled Oct 25. Key differentiator we're leading with: dental-only specialization and our reporting dashboard.

Inbound inquiry via the website on Oct 21. Dr. Flores runs a pediatric practice in Ocean Beach — 1 location, focused on growing their new patient volume. Sent intro email. Need to schedule a discovery call this week.

High-value implant-only practice in La Jolla. Wants a custom package: aggressive Google Ads, full website rebuild, and video content. They're negotiating on price — currently at $6,500/mo, they want $5,800. Working on a revised scope to bridge the gap.

Growing client roster means Marcus and Priya are at capacity. Posted JD on LinkedIn and Indeed Oct 5. Received 34 applications. Phone screens scheduled for Oct 24-25. Target start date: Nov 17. Looking for 1-2 years agency or dental industry experience.

Annual Q4 team retreat. Last year we went to Big Bear — looking at Temecula wine country this year for a change. Need to book venue, plan agenda (Q4 retro + 2027 strategy), and coordinate travel for 8 people. Budget: $4,000.

Annual vendor renewals due Nov 1: Sprout Social ($580/mo), SEMrush ($299/mo), CallRail ($195/mo), Canva Teams ($60/mo), and Monday.com ($420/mo). Comparing SEMrush vs Ahrefs pricing — Ahrefs is $30/mo cheaper with similar features. Decision needed by Oct 28.

updates.item_name: Sunshine Dental - Google Ads Q4 Campaign
updates.body: Google Ads CPL down to $42 this week 🎉 Was at $58 in Q3. Switched to Target CPA bidding on the implant ad group and tightened the geo radius to 8 miles. Sunshine Dental is going to love this in the October report.

replies.body: Great work Tyler — that's a massive improvement. I'll make sure to feature the CPL trend chart prominently in the October report.

updates.body: Dr. Martinez reviewed the homepage and services pages today — she loves the new design direction. Her only feedback was to soften the hero headline copy. Devon is updating the copy now. We're still on track for Nov 15 launch.

replies.body: Copy updates done! New headline is 'Your Smile, Our Passion' — Dr. Martinez will love it. Sending revised mockup tonight.

updates.body: Sunshine Dental now ranking #3 for 'dentist San Diego' — up from #8 in July. The citation building and location page work is paying off. Hillcrest/North Park cluster is at #1 for 'family dentist Hillcrest'. Will have the full rank report ready for the October deliverable.

replies.body: This is huge! Dr. Park is going to be thrilled. #1 for family dentist Hillcrest is exactly what she wanted.

updates.body: Lakeside Dental signed! Starting November 1st 🦷 Contract fully executed this morning. Kick-off call booked for Oct 24 at 10am. Natalie is initiating the onboarding checklist. This is a great win for the team — 4 locations with strong implant volume.

replies.body: Congrats team!! Really excited about this one. Tyler already started on the implant campaign keyword research.
Access to practice management software granted — they use Dentrix. Setting up call tracking numbers today.

updates.body: New creative tests are live as of this morning. Testing 'Free New Patient Exam' offer vs 'Meet Dr. Park' brand hook across two ad sets with a 45+ homeowner audience vs our original broad 25-55 targeting. Will have enough data by Oct 27 to make a call.

All 6 patient before/after photos received from Dr. Nguyen's office — consent forms on file. Designing the Instagram carousel template today. Planning to run as both organic posts and boosted content. Devon's first draft will be ready for Priya's review tomorrow.

replies.body: Perfect — I'll review and send to Dr. Nguyen for final approval. She was really excited about this campaign idea.

updates.item_name: Pacific Coast Smiles - New Mover Campaign
updates.body: October update: 14 new patient calls attributed to the new mover campaign in the first 30 days. Dr. Nguyen confirmed 6 of those have booked appointments. That's a 43% call-to-appointment rate — well above our 30% benchmark. Client is very happy.

October SEO content review done. Marcus approved all 4 blog posts and the on-page rewrites. Submitting to Dr. Nguyen's office for a quick look before we publish. Should be live by Oct 27. GMB cleanup is already done — added 14 new photos and updated service descriptions.

Call with Dr. Albright at Elite Dental today. He's serious about signing but stuck on price. Proposed a revised scope: keeping Google Ads and website build, deferring video production to Month 3 as an add-on. This gets us to $5,900/mo — close to his number. Awaiting response.

replies.body: That's a smart approach — get them signed and prove value first, then upsell video. I'd push for $6,000 as the floor though.

updates.body: Google Ads data pulled from the dashboard — strong month. Total clicks up 22% MoM, CPL down to $42, 3 conversion campaigns all above target. Tyler flagged the Q4 budget recommendation we should include: suggests increasing spend to $3,000/mo in November to capture holiday season demand.

34 applications in — quality looks solid this round. Narrowed to 8 candidates for phone screens next week. Top candidates have either dental office or marketing agency experience. Sarah will join for the final round interviews. Targeting an offer by Nov 7.

Demo confirmed for Oct 28 at 2pm — will be with Dr. Singh and their office manager. Preparing a custom deck showing their competitors' Google ad spend and estimated new patient volume. Our dental-specific case studies will be the centerpiece. Sarah presenting.

Follow-up email sent to Dr. Chen after the proposal. She replied saying she's reviewing with her business partner. She had a question about the website timeline — I confirmed 8-10 weeks from contract signing, which would be January launch. Strong buying signals.

All 16 posts scheduled in Sprout Social through Oct 31. Dr. Martinez approved the Halloween content — 'Don't let candy trick your teeth' theme with the team in scrubs. Engagement has been strong this month: avg 4.2% engagement rate vs 2.8% industry benchmark.

Ahrefs vs SEMrush comparison done. Ahrefs is $30/mo cheaper and has better backlink data, but SEMrush has the PPC keyword research features Tyler relies on. Recommending we keep SEMrush given Tyler's workflow. All other renewals are straightforward — will process by Oct 28.

docs.name: Dental Marketing Playbook 2026
docs.content_summary: The agency's master playbook for dental practice marketing. Covers the full service stack (paid search, SEO, social, content, website), channel strategy by practice type (GP, ortho, implant-focused, pediatric), new patient acquisition benchmarks by market, and campaign launch checklists. Updated quarterly. Used in new client onboarding and team training.

docs.name: New Client Onboarding Checklist
docs.content_summary: Step-by-step onboarding checklist for every new dental practice client. Covers: contract execution, access collection (GMB, website, Facebook BM, Google Ads, practice management software), call tracking setup (CallRail), baseline reporting snapshot, kick-off call agenda, and 30/60/90 day milestone plan. Owned by operations.

docs.name: Monthly Reporting Template
docs.content_summary: Standard template for monthly client performance reports. Sections: executive summary, new patient metrics (calls, form fills, attributed appointments), paid media performance (impressions, clicks, CPL, ROAS), SEO summary (rank movements, organic traffic, GMB actions), social media metrics, and next month recommendations. Clients receive PDF via email by the 28th of each month.

docs.name: Agency Growth Strategy Q4 2026
docs.content_summary: Q4 2026 growth strategy for the agency. Covers revenue targets (current MRR $10,600, Q4 target $17,000 with Elite Dental, Lakeside, and Downtown Dental closing), capacity planning for the new AM hire, service expansion opportunities (video production, reputation management), and 2027 planning priorities. Reviewed in leadership sync.

forms.name: New Client Intake Form
forms.description: Intake form for new dental practice clients to submit practice details, contact information, current marketing setup, goals, and access credentials. Sent immediately after contract signing as the first step in onboarding.

forms.name: Monthly Report Feedback Form
forms.description: Short feedback form sent to dental practice clients alongside each monthly report. Captures satisfaction score (1-5), highlights they found most valuable, areas for improvement, and any questions for the account team. Responses feed back into the Monthly Reporting board.

forms.name: New Business Inquiry
forms.description: Inbound inquiry form for dental practices interested in working with the agency. Captures practice name, location count, services of interest, current monthly marketing spend, and biggest marketing challenge. Reviewed by Sarah Kim within 1 business day.

dashboards.name: Client Portfolio Overview
dashboards.description: Executive overview of all dental practice clients and prospects. Shows total MRR by client, client retention health, pipeline value from active prospects, account owner workload, and retainer renewal dates. Reviewed by Sarah Kim in weekly leadership sync.

dashboards.name: Campaign Performance Dashboard
dashboards.description: Aggregate campaign performance across all active dental practice clients. Tracks total new patient calls, average CPL by channel (Google Ads, Facebook, new mover), website traffic by client, and SEO rank movements. Refreshed weekly. Used by account managers for client check-ins.

dashboards.name: Agency Revenue & Capacity
dashboards.description: Internal agency financial and capacity dashboard. Shows current MRR, projected MRR with pipeline, client count per account manager, open project count by team member, and hiring status. Used by leadership to make staffing and capacity decisions.
